Description: Fills the area of effect with a set of immobile smells. The smells are real (no RR) and detecting that it is an illusion can normally only be accomplished through spells or the use of a sense other than sight

Target is struck with the equivalent of a bare fist (the attack is invisible unless combined with the visual sense in an Illusion or Phantasm). Treat as a Martial Arts Striking Rank I attack. Directed Spells skill may be developed for this attack
As Smell Mirage, except a set of tastes can be created

Creates a 10'R cloud of noxious gas that will stun anyone failing to resist (all targets must make a RR each round they are in cloud). The cloud drifts with the wind. Targets failing their RR are stunned for 1 round per 10 failure

As Smell Mirage, except all the objects and surfaces in a 10'R can be made to feel differently than they really are. Striking an object or surface will cancel the spell for that object or surface only
One object (up to 10 pounds per level) has either its taste, its smell, or the way its surface feels altered for the duration of the spell. Note that the visual aspects of the object do not change
As Strike I, except range is 300'
As Tear Cloud I, except radius is 20'
As Feel Mirage I, except objects with a feel mirage on them must be struck three times before the feeling is cancelled
As Strike I, except range is 500'

All of the terrain in the area of effect will feel differently than it actually does. The caster may designate in what way the terrain feels differently. For example, flat ground could be made to feel rocky; or rocky ground could be made to feel flat
As many objects as the caster's level can be given individual smells and tastes
As Tear Cloud I, except radius is 50'
As Feel Mirage I, except objects must be struck five times
As many objects as the caster's level can be given individual feeling surfaces
As Feel Mirage I, except objects must be struck seven times
As Feel Mirage I, except objects must be struck ten times
As Smell Mirage, except one object can be given a smell permanently
As Taste Mirage, except one object can be given a taste permanently

As Feel Mirage I, except one object can be to permanently feel differently than it really is. SPECIAL NOTES See 7.1.27 for more information on illusions, mirages, etc. ILLUSIONIST BASE LIST 3.3.1 FEEL-TASTE-SMELL
